answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 8942 Country: India Title: Watching the TV, is permit in shriyat-e- islam. please send fatwa in details, (2) leisten flimy songs, are permit in islam send me details. Question: asalamu alaikum, Watching the TV, is permit in shriyat-e- islam. please send fatwa in details, (2) leisten flimy songs, are permit in islam send me details. khuda hafiz. Answer ID: 8942 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (1) Television has become an instrument of fun and amusement, it is root cause of evils; therefore it is unlawful to watch it. (2) It is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
